picks.editorial_note: Purdue landing two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals a major new federal push to fuse AI with national-lab science, from collider data pipelines to broader discovery workflows.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: A £20 million MRC-funded hub at Cambridge combining stem-cell tissue models with AI could meaningfully shorten drug development timelines — a concrete, well-funded bet on AI-accelerated medicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida teaming up on the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM initiative shows AI moving into life-critical clinical procedures like intubation, with real deployment stakes.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's Jason Zhang using generative AI to design proteins never seen in nature, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's work, represents a genuine frontier advance in AI-driven molecular design.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial tumor proteomics offers a new AI approach to predicting cancer treatment response across tumor types — a substantive scientific contribution to oncology.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's DOE Genesis Mission Phase I funding for AI-driven quantum error correction extends the same national AI-for-science initiative into a distinct, high-stakes computing domain.
picks.title: UCR researchers join DOE effort to speed scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes a much-needed unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — infrastructure the field currently lacks.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: A $12 million Army Research Laboratory grant for animal-inspired AI sensing in autonomous drones and robots is a substantial defense-backed bet on next-generation battlefield perception.
picks.title: $12M grant to build animal-inspired sensing for autonomous drones and robots | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: A URI-founded startup's NPU-optimization software being absorbed by AMD is a concrete industry validation of university AI research, with direct commercial impact on large language model efficiency.
picks.title: URI professors’ startup team joined semiconductor giant AMD

picks.editorial_note: Hebrew University's Haim Sompolinsky winning the 2026 Dirac Medal recognizes foundational statistical-mechanics theory underpinning modern AI and neuroscience — a career achievement with lasting scientific influence.
picks.title: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem Congratulates Prof. Haim Sompolinsky on Receiving the 2026 Dirac Medal
